structured_output.what_is_happening: VSOF 'Vanguard Strategic Oil Fund' is a 37-minute-old copycat of a VSOF ticker that is already big elsewhere. The packet lists a VSOF pump.fun token at about $3.8B reported market cap with $5.6M liquidity, plus several other large VSOF copies. This contract did not come from pump.fun: its address has no 'pump' suffix and launchpad is null. The pool was created on PumpSwap 3 seconds after the mint, and the creator supplied the liquidity (about $35k, more than the $26k market cap). None of the LP is locked or burned. The creator still holds 12.7% of supply. The creator has launched 2 tokens and its 'best token ATH' ($731M) matches another same-name contract in the packet (4QPcyu…), which now has zero volume and a meaningless market cap. So this is a serial copycat deployer. Volume is about $986k in under an hour, 27x turnover. GeckoTerminal shows about 2,057 unique buyers but only 54 unique sellers, and wallets outside the top 40 hold just 1% of supply. That points to bot-sprayed buys that inflate the holder count and volume. Price hit its high about 35% above the current level and fell about 20% in the last 5 minutes. Buys and sells are now roughly even.

narrative.description: Copies the hot VSOF 'Vanguard Strategic Oil Fund' meta, a trending ticker with multiple large-cap versions on pump.fun. This coin brings no story of its own and has no website or profile. The only link is an X handle (vsofofficial) listed on GeckoTerminal.
narrative.why_spreading: Attention comes from the VSOF ticker already trending elsewhere. Traders searching the ticker may land on copies. The activity here looks mostly bot- or deployer-driven, not organic.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name and ticker. It is a late copy made by a dev who has already deployed at least one other same-name copy.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 other VSOF tokens. The canonical one looks like gBii…pump ($3.8B reported mcap, $5.6M liquidity), followed by 4m9Y…pump ($420M mcap), 9Ln2…pump, CQZW…pump and 2R7r…pump. Several non-pump copies have already died with near-zero liquidity, including one from this same creator.

authenticity.evidence: 2,057 unique buyers against 54 unique sellers, and the long tail holds only 1% of supply: typical of wallet spraying. A self-deployed PumpSwap pool with creator-seeded, unlocked LP. The creator holds 12.7% and is tagged as a rat trader. The creator has a prior same-name copy that is now dead. No DexScreener profile, no boosts, no smart or renowned wallets, and only 2 GMGN page visits.
